description:
Ask plain-language questions about your team and organization—answered with data from your Workleap account.

Instead of navigating dashboards, ask things like "What's our engagement score this month?", "Who is the new hire on my team?", or "Show me my recent recognition" and get a concise, visual answer.

What it covers:
- Engagement scores, eNPS, and participation trends—for your team or the whole org
- Employee profiles, hire dates, and reporting relationships
- Recognition cards you've sent and received
- Team structures and org context, so references like "my direct reports" resolve automatically

Built for managers and HR teams who want faster access to the signals already in Workleap, without switching tools.

defaultPrompt: What's the engagement score of the Customer Support team?
Tell me more about Daniel, the new hire
